title: Review of c06's pcell-efficiency claim (SIDH): replicates on fresh seed 9 against the inert marker (deaths at yield percentile 0.06 vs 0.56; mean yield 1.16 vs marker 1.01), with a giant cell from t~22000
summary: Fresh seed 9 (T=100000): labkit pack (8 persistent splits, generation 2, merge/split 0.22) and the author's exact genealogy (16 persistent splits, generation 5, 34 intrinsic deaths, 0 merges, 0 conversions). Particle-weighted mean yield rises 1.00 -> 1.16 by t~50000 and holds, while the identical-event inert marker stays at 1.01. Mature-cell deaths sit at the 6th yield percentile (23/23 below the median; 2000 t before death, the 11th, 19/19), against the 56th (59th) for the marker. Dying cells were already low at birth (mean birth rank 0.37, falling to 0.05 at death; marker 0.56 -> 0.54), and low-born cells die more often than high-born ones (0.63 vs 0.42; marker the reverse, 0.41 vs 0.69). Splits are not selected (percentile 0.47). As on the parent world, yield tracks cell size among living cells (Spearman 0.76), and one body grows into a giant covering about a third of the domain from t~22000 to the end (sheet.png).

observations.S: rerun/seed9/sheet.png t=0: uniform particle soup and noisy phi; ~20 cells by t=4000
observations.I: rerun/seed9/sheet.png: bounded walled cells t=4000-100000 (plus one giant body from t~22000)
observations.D: rerun/seed9/lineage.png: 8 persistent splits, generation 2; data/gen_s9.log: 16 persistent splits, generation 5, 0 merges
observations.H: data/selection_s9.txt: death percentile yield 0.062 vs marker 0.56; lagged 2000 t 0.115 vs 0.59; mean yield 1.163 vs marker 1.009 at t=100000; birth rank of dying cells 0.37 vs 0.56; death share low-born 0.63 vs high-born 0.42

controls_run.H: data/selection_s9.txt: identical-event inert marker zm in the same run (same particles and mutation process, no effect)

verdicts.limitation: Selection runs only through deaths and through cell size (Spearman 0.76 between yield and particle count): high-yield cells are big cells that outlast small neighbours, and on this seed one body becomes a giant holding about a third of the domain for the last 78000 t, so much of the late population is one individual. The trait is continuous and capped at an imposed 1.2, and the mean response saturates by t~50000.
